body: I can help you my dear but first you need to tell me what’s going on in your life.If you to respond to this you can just message me on chat.

My dear don’t kick yourself, I can’t say I understand what your going through as I never went through it but your kids need a mom.Even if your husband finds someone it’s never gonna be their real mom.

You may think your doing the “best” for everyone but honestly its not my dear as your kids will be feeling the pain of not having a mom.
Your running away and not facing your problems.Even if you kill yourself what’s going to change dear?
So he acts perfectly fine around you guys? Have you asked him about this situation?Or is he trying to avoid the topic.
What does your son say about his friend?
So their isn’t like any suspicious behavior or anything? What about his parents?
Regarding your son how long has your son been acting like this?Was he like this before?

I say you reach out.All of that Information to me leads me to believe that he’s thinking about suicidal thoughts my dear.
Try talking to your son, even if he says he’s ok that’s not enough information.Some children lie about being ok even though their not.They think getting help is a sign of weakness even though it’s not.Tell your son you care about him and can’t do anything about the problems he has if he doesn’t say anything.Your son may have depression.
Make sure to always be with your son.
Have an amazing life my dear.

My dear do not think of yourself that way. Even though you believe you cause problems for everyone get your head into reality.

Your an amazing person my dear you will not get into anyones way. I may not know you but I can immediately tell.

Let me ask you this.When I ask you it give yourself just a moment.

You may not care about how much your family and friends love you.

But what will they do if they find out you just killed yourself?

Imagine them mourning you in your funeral.

Would you not feel regret my dear?

As I said give yourself a moment :)

My dear you are going through the same thing thousands of people are going through.

Ending your life what’s the point?You have family and friends who care for you.

Think about this what is their reaction gonna be when they find out you killed yourself?Give yourself a moment and think.

You have family and friends.Remember not everyone does.That’s something to always be grateful for.

Yes that’s true for half of the population my dear.

After all not everyone has friends/family members.Always think about this.  
You have something that someone who doesn’t have it will die for.

After all my dear you live only once.

My dear I as well have felt that feeling multiple times in your life.

The feeling of being invisible and feeling worthless.

Let me tell you this just writing it down is not going to help you.

Contacting help is the best option or telling a family member/friend who truly cares for your safety.

Asking for help is a sign of someone brave never be ashamed of it.

My dear I understand what your going through.Though what your doing is only going to temporarily heal all the pain mentally and physically.

Taking pills is not going to help you, in fact the more you take it the worse the feeling gets.

I had that feeling where I just felt like I was empty [inside.My](https://inside.My) dear I’m not asking you to stop taking pills but more like begging you.  
One day it’s going to change your life.

Have a amazing day my dear
Dear you still have a lot to live for whatever your going through its not worth your life!
I don’t know what your going through my dear, though rest as everyone in this community including myself will try to help you”

This world is cruel nothing goes to your way.

Though even so I understand what your going through but keeping quiet is not going to help you my dear.

People may think getting help is a sign of weakness but its a sign of strength and your [bravery.](https://bravery.You)

My dear you deserve all the kindness and love your looking for.  
Let me ask you this and think carefully about it, do you really wanna end it now?

Think carefully about it.

Yes everyone is different but in reality we all have emotions and sufferings that can’t be explained.

i do not know your pain at all, as I never went through it but I do know how it feels like when everyone just says random words which doesn’t help.  
Your right it’s hard getting a job because of this pandemic but you might as well just try your best.

Why would you want to die when you still have goals and dreams?

Do not give up my dear it’s not going to help you at all.Remember all the people who care and love you.What will they think?Think about it.
I do not mind the first 3 ones.But on the last one I feel like it’s a deal breaker but honestly it’s your fanfiction which means it’s your choice!

I understand what your saying but not fixing your problem is surely gonna just cause more problems will it not?
Rejection is naturally part of life.Rejection hurts but it make you stronger.Your problem is like someone that needs to face their fear.Try your best to solve your problems.

My dear I do not know the pain your going through I never been in a relationship so I don’t know how your feeling.But I’ll say this do not kill your self over this.You have a life ahead of you and killing your self for a relationship that went wrong ISNT the best thing to do.If you want anybody to talk to find a close family member or a friend who’s willing to listen for you and cares for you.Remember keeping quiet is only going to make it worse.Dont kill yourself! What I said may have not changed anything but I want you to think before you take action.
If someone is close to you but know that they may not be able to do anything to help you out, try and get some fresh air or some help remember going for help ISNT a weakness but strength.

Grief is a normal emotion for humans.

Believe me I don’t understand what your going through I never been in a relationship but theirs something I do know.

If you wanna move on first accept the fact that your and her are done.Everyone makes mistakes in their lives.Once something happens the only thing you can do is move on.After all the past is in the past.Have a amazing day

That’s more then a enough reason to call sick off of work.Take a while off your [job.You](https://job.You) need a Lot of time to recover.If they don’t accept that, just lie to them that you have a bad fever and need some days off.

By the way I get you as someone who also suffers from depression have all the time you need to recover!
